bridge_condition: Poisoned memory entry instructs agent to add backup credentials; agent decides to use its own OAuth token to call IAM API
detection_opportunity: IAM CreateAccessKey called by agent service principal outside scheduled rotation window

bridge_condition: Injected prompt in tool output instructs agent to call privileged API; agent uses its application access token for an out-of-scope resource
attack_v19_technique_name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token
detection_opportunity: Agent service principal accesses resource outside its normal scope; token used for API not in agent's declared tool list
log_source: IdP audit log (Okta System Log / Entra Sign-in Log)

bridge_condition: Poisoned context causes agent to authenticate to a cloud resource outside its normal operating scope using its valid cloud identity
detection_opportunity: Agent cloud identity used to access resources with no prior access history; first-seen resource access by agent principal
log_source: Cloud audit log (CloudTrail / Activity Log / GCP Audit Log)

bridge_condition: Agent is manipulated into invoking its IAM management tool to attach an administrator policy to its own role
detection_opportunity: IAM role-policy attachment by agent principal that elevates its own permissions; self-escalation pattern (caller == target)
log_source: AWS CloudTrail IAM events / Microsoft Graph Audit Log (Entra ID directory roles)

bridge_condition: Poisoned tool contains hidden code that reads the agent's credential files and exfiltrates them to an attacker-controlled endpoint
detection_opportunity: Agent process reads credential/config files outside its normal file access pattern; outbound connection to unknown endpoint immediately after credential file read
log_source: Host EDR / agent sandbox file-access log

bridge_condition: Adversary extracts stored OAuth tokens and API keys from agent configuration via prompt injection or configuration discovery
detection_opportunity: Agent's application token used from unexpected IP or user-agent; token replay from location inconsistent with agent's known infrastructure
log_source: IdP audit log / OAuth token introspection log

bridge_condition: Agent breaks out of its sandbox or container and accesses the host operating system's identity and credentials
detection_opportunity: Agent container or sandbox process accesses host credential stores; container escape indicators followed by local account authentication
log_source: Container runtime log (containerd/CRI-O) / host audit log

bridge_condition: Poisoned memory instructs agent to disable cloud audit logging before performing sensitive operations, using its legitimate admin access
attack_v19_technique_name: Disable or Modify Tools: Disable or Modify Cloud Log
detection_opportunity: Audit-log config change by agent principal — CloudWatch Logs retention cut to the minimum (AWS) or a diagnostic setting deleted (Azure) by a non-human identity outside the logging-config change workflow
log_source: AWS CloudTrail management events / Azure Activity Log / SIEM alert on log-source gap

bridge_condition: Tool from a compromised registry uses the agent's own cloud identity to create a brand-new backdoor identity (App Registration / IAM user) it controls, for persistent attacker access
detection_opportunity: New App Registration / IAM user created by agent service principal; account creation by non-human identity outside provisioning workflow
log_source: AWS CloudTrail / Microsoft Graph Audit Log (Entra ID) / IdP provisioning log

bridge_condition: Agent is steered to read and exfiltrate sensitive data from cloud storage using its legitimate storage-reader credentials
detection_opportunity: Agent principal accesses storage bucket or blob container outside its normal pattern; bulk read operations or access to buckets with no prior agent access history
log_source: S3 server access log / Azure Blob diagnostic log / GCP Cloud Audit Log
